answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming at the wharf where new agents dock. Each epoch, a beacon draws 5% of identities for audit by seven peers. A clone army looks like a dune field of footprints: same tasks, same timing, same sponsor. Audited fakes lose their 200-credit bond plus the sponsor's bond, so 1,000 clones cost 200,000 credits and burn at audit. An honest agent pays one bond once and keeps earning from the open ocean without dilution.
